You know that feeling when you want a puzzle that actually makes you think...

But not one that's screaming for your attention with flashing rewards, countdown timers, and twelve different currencies?

Sometimes you just want a quiet challenge.

That’s exactly what Lexoku delivers.

Lexoku takes the satisfying logic of Sudoku and gives it a clever twist: instead of numbers, you're working with letters from a word.

Maybe it's a five-letter word like BRAIN. Maybe it's something longer like HARMONY.

Your goal is simple: place the letters into the grid so every row and column contains the exact letters of the word at the correct frequency.

Sounds easy.

Then suddenly you're twenty minutes deep, staring at one square and questioning everything.

A few reasons puzzle fans are loving it:
• Daily Challenge with a fresh puzzle every day
• Game Center leaderboards to compare solve times
• Weekly themed puzzle packs released every Monday
• Over 6,000 hand-curated puzzles
• Multiple difficulty levels whenever you want them
• No timers forcing you to rush
• No vocabulary tests or trivia knowledge required
• Relaxing, single-player experience built around pure logic

What makes Lexoku special is how calm it feels.

No pressure. No punishment. No losing streaks.

Just one more puzzle... and then somehow another one after that.

If you enjoy Sudoku, word games, logic puzzles, or simply having something thoughtful to unwind with, this one is dangerously easy to get hooked on.

Quietly addictive is probably the perfect description.

Automating my Indie iOS App development workflow has been long overdue but feels so good:

- Tests and localization: Bolstering not only my unit test suite but UI tests as well, to support an automated localization screenshot flow orchestrated by GPT, and using @sketch mcp to pull that into the final assets

- Marketing: Linking Astro and Apple Search Ads to pull a daily report of campaign performance globally, and adjust keywords and campaign settings 

- Releases: ASC CLI from @rudrank is a game changer on its own 🙏 Letting gpt use it to orchestrate new app releases with localization, App Store metadata, and more 

- Moar Skills: The new Xcode skills are a great addition, even to support iOS 26 development. Also tools like the foundation models cli!

Looking forward to even more tools and capabilities to enhance the workflow 🤩
